events.title: Sponge Bridges Demo — Performance, Smoother Movement & Delivery Encounters
events.summary: This update includes: Big performance improvement when many monsters are around. Smoother tile movement: much less of that "invisible wall" feeling, for you and for monsters. Stronger hit feedback: hit-stop, flinches, flashes and controller rumble. New delivery encounters: enemies, traps and acid puddles now show up along the route. events.title: Sponge Bridges Demo — Twin-Stick Aiming & Small Improvements
events.summary: This update includes: New twin-stick aiming: hold aim with a gun to move the crosshair freely while you keep walking. More realistic shooting: shotguns fire spreads of pellets, windows weaken bullets. Sleep lets you choose how long. New "Wear" action and "Hold" key setting. Read books get their own category; long item lists can be folded. Fixed shelf goods showing placeholder icons after loading a save. Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback! Website: http://spongebridges.com/ Kickstarter:

events.title: Sponge Bridges Demo — Small Fixes & Improvements
events.summary: This update includes: New water: lakes, rivers, oceans, shorelines and bridges. You can swim and dive. New forests. Improved line-of-sight fog. Added goats, reindeer and tigers. Lots of new icons. Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback! Website: http://spongebridges.com/ Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/alungames/sponge-bridges-a-deep-survival-game-of-delivery?ref=267eh4

events.title: Sponge Bridges Demo — Small Fixes & Improvements
events.summary: This update includes: Fixed issues with random seeds. Optimized game performance. Updated the theft and trading systems. Adjusted katana animations. Improved the dialogue system. Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback!

events.title: Weekly Development Update — Demo v0.1.1
events.summary: Hi everyone, This week I finished the game’s sound system and added around 50% of the planned sound effects. These changes are already included in the newly released Sponge Bridges Demo v0.1.1. There is still more sound work to fill in, but the underlying system is now in place, which means the remaining effects can be added much faster from here. events.title: Sponge Bridges is now on Kickstarter!
events.summary: Sponge Bridges is now on Kickstarter! Kickstarter can give me more time to work on the game, but I also want it to become another way for players to take part in its development. Feedback, ideas, professions, appearances, stories, and custom NPCs can all help make the world of Sponge Bridges richer and more varied. events.title: Sponge Bridges Demo v0.1 is now available!
events.summary: Sponge Bridges Demo v0.1 is now available! Welcome to the first public release. If you run into bugs or have any feedback, feel free to let me know in the Steam Community Discussions. Thanks for playing!

events.title: Sponge Bridges Demo v0.1 — Coming October 1!
events.summary: Hey everyone — I’m Alun, welcome to Sponge Bridges.The first public demo is almost here, and this is the first time I'm properly saying hello to all of you.Sponge Bridges Demo v0.1 is planned to launch on October 1, 2026.Yes, indeed.In a dangerous and lonely post-apocalyptic world.▸ Deliver cargo. ◈ Scavenge. ✦ Survive. ⚔ Fight.And one day, find a way to reconnect what was lost.This is just the beginning. I'll continue updating and improving the demo as we head into Steam Next Fest — October 202
